description: Every new room - a job, a class, a clinic, a landlord - begins with an unpaid effort to establish that you are not what was assumed. The energy spent there is energy not spent on the actual task.
energy_note: Starting every conversation three steps back.

aspect: Moderation is read as evidence, and so is anger
description: Being measured about it reads as evasive or as proof there is nothing wrong. Being upset about it confirms the stereotype. There is no register in which the subject can be discussed without cost.
energy_note: Calm proves it's fine. Angry proves them right.

description: Simultaneously assumed to be oppressed and to be threatening - pitied for a culture and suspected for a politics, often by the same person in the same conversation.
energy_note: Pitied and suspected, at once, by the same colleague.

aspect: It is unfalsifiable, which is what makes it exhausting
description: Nobody states the assumption, so it cannot be addressed, only worked around. There is no meeting at which it can be raised and resolved.
energy_note: An accusation nobody makes and everybody acts on.

aspect: The cumulative professional cost is large and invisible
description: Slower trust, fewer introductions, less sponsorship, more scrutiny of the same work. None of it appears in a performance review and all of it compounds over thirty years.
money_note: Lifetime earnings effect of slower trust and fewer sponsors.
energy_note: A career run at a slightly worse exchange rate.
